rows.en: The Bird Human's head: another AFOS fragment, newly found on Mayan Island.\nFind it before the Anti-U.N. Forces do and bring it to the target area.
rows.notes: review: refit: L2 refers to the head as "it" (named in L1)

rows.en: Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces so they\ncan't recover the Bird Human's head.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured, purpose clause moved to the end

rows.en: We lost the Bird Human's head in a fierce battle with the Anti-U.N. Forces.\nWe can't let them recover it. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces searching for it.
rows.notes: review: refit: "lost track of ... after" to "lost ... in"

rows.en: To seize the immense power of AFOS,\nwipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

rows.en: To seize the immense power of AFOS,\nwipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

rows.en: To seize the immense power of AFOS,\nwipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

rows.en: To seize the AFOS fragment,\nwipe out the U.N. Forces.
To seize the AFOS fragment being studied by the U.N. Forces, we will now\nraid the carrier Asuka. Wipe out the U.N. escorts and seize the AFOS fragment.
rows.notes: Carrier written as 'Asuka' in the source; glossary lists 'Asuka II'. Kept the game's short form 'the carrier Asuka'. Break kept mid-sentence as in source. | review: refit: "escorting U.N. units" to "U.N. escorts"

rows.en: To seize the immense power of AFOS,\nwipe out the U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our Anti-U.N. Forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: second mention "U.N."

rows.en: Wipe out the giant aliens who struck back\nafter the Macross's attack.
During its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet.\nBattle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position at once.
rows.notes: review: refit: "unidentified space fleet" to "unknown fleet"

rows.en: Wipe out the giant aliens who struck back\nafter the Macross's attack.
During its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet.\nBattle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position at once.
rows.notes: review: refit: "unidentified space fleet" to "unknown fleet"

rows.en: Wipe out the giant alien ground forces\nattacking the Macross.
To escape the giant aliens' attack, the Macross now attempts a space launch.\nEscort the blundering VF-1D while wiping out the giant alien ground forces.
rows.notes: The VF-1D 'flying around the battlefield recklessly/aimlessly' (Hikaru's civilian joyride); rendered 'blundering around'. | review: refit: "blundering around the battlefield" to "blundering"

rows.en: Defend the Macross\nduring the Transformation.
rows.notes: Source uses a rougher imperative form; 'Transformation' capitalised as the Macross's mode-change name.

rows.en: Beginning the Transformation to fire the main gun at the giant alien fleet.\nDefend the Macross at all costs while the Transformation is under way.
rows.notes: review: refit: L1 restructured; L2 unchanged

rows.en: As part of your training,\nfight a mock battle against Major Focker.
Our rookies lack experience, so we'll now hold a mock battle as training.\nWin the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.
rows.notes: review: refit: L1 restructured; L2 aligned with row 233 (same source line)

rows.en: Defend the Macross until\nits main gun fires.
To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens.\nDefend the Macross until its main gun fires.
rows.notes: review: refit: "purely defensive" to "defensive", "launch a surprise attack on" to "surprise-attack"

rows.en: Defend the Macross until\nits main gun fires.
To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens.\nDefend the Macross until its main gun fires.
rows.notes: review: refit: "purely defensive" to "defensive", "launch a surprise attack on" to "surprise-attack"

rows.en: To resupply, carry the containers\nto the designated point.
With supplies drained by repeated battles, we'll restock at Sara Base on Mars.\nRecover the supply containers. If enemies appear, switch to wiping them out.
rows.notes: Mars base name (romaji Sara kichi) rendered 'Sara Base'; not in glossary. | review: term now in glossary | review: refit: restructured both lines

rows.en: Destroy the enemies nearing the Macross.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'enemy units approaching' -> 'enemies nearing'

rows.en: Enemy units spotted approaching the Macross. A scramble has been ordered.\nMiss Macross may be on your mind, but go at once and wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: Escort the Cat's Eye until the survey\nof the giant aliens is complete.
Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender.\nWe'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: review: refit: "the enemy's true intent" to "their aims"

rows.en: Escort the Cat's Eye until the survey\nof the giant aliens is complete.
Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender.\nWe'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: review: refit: "the enemy's true intent" to "their aims"

rows.en: To escape from the enemy ship,\nhead for the target area.
We've rescued Lt. Hayase and the others held captive on a Zentradi battleship,\nbut we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.
rows.notes: Rank chuui -> 'Lieutenant' (army-style ranks, matching Major Focker for shousa). | review: refit: "Lieutenant" to "Lt.", second "enemy ship" to "it"

rows.en: To make it back to Earth no matter what,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Zentradi have surrounded the Macross to stop it from returning to Earth.\nIt's a hard-line move, but destroy the Zentradi to break their encirclement.
rows.notes: review: refit: "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi", tighter wording

rows.en: Wipe out the Zentradi forces\nthat have attacked the Macross.
The Zentradi have attacked the Macross, back on Earth after a year away.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces trying to smoke the Macross out into space.
rows.notes: 'returned to Earth after a year' rendered as 'back on Earth for the first time in a year'. | review: refit: "for the first time in a year" to "after a year away"; L2 unchanged

rows.en: To keep the enemy off the Macross,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'away from' -> 'off'

rows.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

rows.en: To keep the enemy off the Macross,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'away from' -> 'off'

rows.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

rows.en: To keep the enemy off the Macross,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'away from' -> 'off'

rows.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

rows.en: To keep the enemy off the Macross,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'away from' -> 'off'

rows.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

rows.en: To get the civilians safely onto Earth,\nwipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Ontario Autonomous Zone has agreed to take in the Macross's civilians, but\nthe Zentradi have appeared. Wipe them out so the civilians can be taken in.
rows.notes: Source breaks mid-phrase before 'appeared'; English breaks after 'but' at the matching point. | review: refit: restructured (Zone as subject), second Zentradi mention as "them"

rows.en: Escort the liaison shuttle headed\nfor U.N. Forces HQ on Earth.
You'll now escort the liaison shuttle taking Capt. Hayase to U.N. HQ on Earth.\nEscort it until it reaches a safe zone, then switch to wiping out the enemy.
rows.notes: Rank taii -> 'Captain' (army-style, consistent with Major Focker and Lieutenant Hayase in row 279). Glossary position text says 'Lieutenant Commander'; please confirm the rank scheme. | review: refit: "Captain" to "Capt.", "U.N. Forces HQ" to "U.N. HQ", second "shuttle" to "it"

rows.en: Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit\ngame "Battroid Attack".
rows.notes: In-game arcade title 'Battroid Attack' (spelling from row 297's own English logo). Clause order swapped around the break. | review: term now in glossary

rows.en: Head-to-Head Valkyrie Simulation  ~BATTROID ATTACK!!~\n                                  PLEASE INSERT COIN(S)
rows.notes: Arcade attract-screen text. Full-width spaces converted to ASCII (two per full-width space to keep the right-aligned 'insert coin' line). Logo kept in caps as in source. Spacing may need tuning at insertion.

rows.en: Wipe out the Zentradi forces\nlaunching an all-out attack.
At humanity's first interstellar wedding, the Zentradi hit the Macross all-out.\nWe've taken our first step to peace and can't stop here. Wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: review: refit: "launched an all-out attack on" to "hit ... all-out"

rows.en: To end the interstellar war,\ndestroy Golg Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Source uses the short form of the Zentradi supreme commander's name; full glossary name used.

rows.en: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out.\nWe'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Full name on first mention, 'Boddole Zer' on second. | review: refit: "Golg Boddole Zer" to "Boddole Zer", "hopeless gap in strength" to "hopeless odds"

rows.en: To end the interstellar war,\ndestroy Golg Boddole Zer.
Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out.\nWe'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: review: refit: "Golg Boddole Zer" to "Boddole Zer", "hopeless gap in strength" to "hopeless odds"

rows.en: Put down the rioting Zentradi\nat once.
Zentradi who can't fit in on Earth stole arms and are attacking civilian areas.\nWe cannot let civilians come to harm. Put down the rampaging Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: "civilian residential areas" to "civilian areas", "weapons" to "arms"; L2 unchanged

rows.en: To capture the automated spaceship\nfactory, seize control of the facility.
rows.notes: Source is redundant ('to seize the factory, occupy the factory'); second verb rendered 'seize control of the facility'. | review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: To build up our forces, we'll capture the Zentradi automated spaceship factory.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces defending the factory and take the factory.
rows.notes: review: refit: "carry out an operation to capture" to "capture"; L2 unchanged

rows.en: To capture the automated spaceship\nfactory, seize control of the facility.
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: To build up our forces, we'll capture the Zentradi automated spaceship factory.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces defending the factory and take the factory.
rows.notes: review: refit: "carry out an operation to capture" to "capture"; L2 unchanged

rows.en: Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is\ntrying to steal the micronization device.
rows.notes: Device name (Micronian + device) rendered 'micronization device'; not in glossary. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Quamzin, who won't coexist with Earthlings, is raiding the factory to steal\nthe micronization device. We can't allow that. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.
rows.notes: Same 'micronization device' as row 310. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: line break moved inside sentence 1; "cannot let them take the device" to "can't allow that"

rows.en: To rescue the hostages,\nwipe out Quamzin's faction.
Quamzin has taken civilians hostage and is demanding a battleship as ransom.\nRescuing the hostages safely comes first. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.
rows.notes: review: refit: L2 restructured; L1 unchanged

rows.en: Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is\ntrying to steal the reaction engine.
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Quamzin's faction is raiding the industrial zone to steal the reaction engine.\nWipe them out to protect the reaction engine in the industrial complex block.
rows.notes: 'kombinat block' (romaji konbinaato burokku) rendered 'industrial complex block'. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: "district" to "zone", second faction mention as "them"

rows.en: To protect the Macross and Macross City,\nwipe out Quamzin's faction.
Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City.\nWipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.
rows.notes: review: refit: "appeared in" to "hit", second faction mention as "them"

rows.en: To protect the Macross and Macross City,\nwipe out Quamzin's faction.
Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City.\nWipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.
rows.notes: review: refit: "appeared in" to "hit", second faction mention as "them"

rows.en: Using melee attacks only,\ndefeat Fleet Commander Vrlitwhai.
